correctness.rationale: For every sufficiently large odd n, upper-bound coefficient counts over at most 2^(k+1) supports; lower-bound exact-support partitions with an injective independent choice of m_j for j>=1 and a parity-forced nonnegative remainder m_0. Quantified parameter choices s=floor((1-epsilon)k) and s=k-ceil(2 log2(k+2)) give matching exponents with O_epsilon(k log k), proving the sharp support deficit rate. The established overpartition weight 2^(J-1) and the negligible sparse-support share yield the sharp ratio exponent. Direct coefficient and recurrence calculations matched for every 1<=n<=2048; no infinite claim rests on enumeration.

value.rationale: Answers the explicit 2023 mathematical suggestion to compare odd-index semi-Fibonacci and semi-Pell growth with an exact polynomial separation exponent. Independently establishes a natural complete sharp logarithmic large-deviation rate epsilon^2/2 for their underlying partition supports. This structural statement goes beyond established parity, bijections, finite tables and unweighted leading-term estimates.
